description: A shimmed disk (smartctl on Linux, diskutil on macOS, first on the root PATH) that passes gives exit 0; one that fails gives exit 1 naming the disk, with a diagnostic block; with no smartctl reachable at all, Linux refuses to call the host healthy (exit 1) and macOS, which reads diskutil, still reports the disk.

steps.label: Install the smartctl and diskutil shims in /usr/local/sbin
Failed (Linux): exit 1 naming the disk and why, with the smartctl output as a diagnostic
Failed (macOS): exit 1 naming the disk and its SMART status, with diskutil info as a diagnostic
outputContains: STATUS=/dev/disk0 SMART status is 'Failing' (0 of 1 disks healthy)

steps.label: Hide every smartctl on the root PATH, the shim and any real one
outputContains: no smartctl on the root PATH

steps.label: smartctl missing (Linux): exit 1, check could not run
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: smartmontools is not installed

steps.label: smartctl missing (macOS): not needed, diskutil still reads the disk, exit 0
